content_sections.heading: SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) Recruitment 2026: Overview
content_sections.text: The SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) Recruitment 2026 is being conducted for experienced professionals in Fire Engineering and Fire Safety. content_sections.heading: SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The State Bank of India has announced the recruitment schedule for Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) posts. Online applications started on 4 November 2026, and the last date for registration and fee payment is 25 November 2026. The online examination is tentatively scheduled for December 2026 or January 2027, followed by interviews in January or February 2027.

content_sections.heading: SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The State Bank of India has announced 17 Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) vacancies for 2026. These include 16 regular vacancies and one backlog vacancy under the Scheduled Tribe category. The vacancies are distributed among Unreserved, SC, ST, OBC and EWS categories as shown below. The number of vacancies is provisional and may change depending on the Bank's requirements. Candidates belonging to reserved categories may also apply for Unreserved vacancies if they meet the eligibility conditions applicable to that category.

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Before applying for SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) Recruitment 2026, candidates should check whether they meet the educational qualification, age limit, post-qualification experience and professional skill requirements. The recruitment is intended for candidates with relevant Fire Engineering qualifications or prescribed Fire Service credentials and practical experience in fire safety. No, freshers are not eligible for SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) Recruitment 2026. Candidates with the prescribed Fire Engineering degree must have at least two years of relevant experience in fire safety. Applicants qualifying through Graduate Membership of the Institution of Fire Engineers or the Divisional Officers Course from NFSC Nagpur must have at least three years of experience in specified Fire Officer or equivalent positions. Candidates without the required post-qualification experience do not meet the eligibility criteria. Important: This is a quick eligibility guide, not confirmation of individual eligibility. Candidates should check the detailed educational qualification, work experience and other conditions in the official SBI notification before applying.

rows.requirements: B.E. / B.Tech in prescribed Fire Engineering or Fire Safety disciplines, equivalent four-year Fire Safety degree, Graduate Membership of Institution of Fire Engineers, or Divisional Officers Course from NFSC Nagpur.
Minimum 2 years in Fire Safety for eligible degree holders, or 3 years in specified Fire Officer positions for candidates with the prescribed professional qualifications.
Fire Prevention, Fire Protection Systems, Fire Safety Audits and Emergency Evacuation Procedures.
Candidates must meet the Bank's medical fitness requirements.

content_sections.heading: SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) Recruitment 2026 must meet the educational qualification and professional experience requirements specified in the official notification. The eligibility cut-off date is 31 October 2026. Applicants should ensure that their qualifications and experience are supported by valid documents. The State Bank of India accepts several Fire Engineering and Fire Service qualifications for the Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) post. Candidates must possess any one of the prescribed qualifications from the relevant recognised institution. The experience requirement for SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) Recruitment 2026 depends on the educational qualification possessed by the candidate. Degree holders must have at least two years of fire safety experience, while applicants qualifying through the prescribed professional membership or Divisional Officers Course must have at least three years of experience in the specified Fire Service roles. Note: Candidates must possess the relevant qualification and full-time work experience as on 31 October 2026. Experience certificates must clearly establish the nature and duration of the required experience. The SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) age limit is 21 to 40 years as on 31 October 2026. The upper age limit of 40 years applies to Unreserved candidates. Relaxation is available to eligible reserved-category candidates according to Government of India guidelines and the conditions stated in the official notification. The State Bank of India provides applicable upper age relaxation to eligible reserved-category candidates according to Government of India guidelines. Candidates seeking relaxation must submit valid supporting certificates when required by SBI. OBC candidates must belong to the Non-Creamy Layer to claim OBC reservation benefits. The notification requires eligible OBC candidates to produce the prescribed certificate containing the Non-Creamy Layer clause. EWS candidates must possess the relevant Income and Asset Certificate based on the financial year 2025-26 and valid for 2026-27. Cumulative age relaxation is not permitted beyond the conditions specified in the notification. Candidates should verify the exact relaxation applicable to their category through the official recruitment rules.

content_sections.text: The SBI Assistant Manager – Engineer (Fire) Selection Process 2026 comprises an online written examination followed by an interview. faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 25 November 2026.

faq.answer: B.E. faq.answer: Yes. Open to Indian citizens. The post is only for medically fit candidates. Good knowledge of fire pump, hydrant, detection and alarm, and sprinkler systems. Knowledge of building evacuation procedure and fire safety audit.

faq.answer: Candidates not meeting age, qualification or experience criteria will not be allowed in the interview and get no travel reimbursement. Employed public sector candidates without NOC at interview will not be considered.

faq.answer: Online written test (objective). Interview. Merit list on normalised scores. Online test: English Language 50 marks, Professional Knowledge 75 marks.
